# Suggested repository labels

Create these labels in **Settings → Labels** so issue templates work as intended:

| Label | Color suggestion | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bug` | `#d73a4a` | Something is broken |
| `enhancement` | `#a2eeef` | New feature or tool idea |
| `good first issue` | `#7057ff` | Small task for new contributors |
| `help wanted` | `#008672` | Maintainer welcomes PRs |
| `documentation` | `#0075ca` | Docs or translation only |

After labels exist, open a few **good first issue** items from [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) (e.g. CSS minifier, Hindi doc gaps) so the links in README and the landing page resolve to real tasks.
